<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_center(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p' and n['pixels']>60:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (round((min(rows)+max(rows))/2,1), round((min(cols)+max(cols))/2,1), min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def block_state(f):
    pur=wh=0
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color'] in 'pW' and min(rows)>=33 and max(rows)<=44 and min(cols)>=26 and max(cols)<=37 and n['pixels']>20:
            if n['color']=='p': pur+=n['pixels']
            else: wh+=n['pixels']
    return (pur,wh)

action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN: piece:", piece_center(current_frame), "block:", block_state(current_frame))
# block center is (38.5, 31.5); 'below' should be ~(49, 31.5)
</parameter>
</function>

def piece_center(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p' and n['pixels']>60:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (round((min(rows)+max(rows))/2,1), round((min(cols)+max(cols))/2,1), min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def block_state(f):
    pur=wh=0
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color'] in 'pW' and min(rows)>=33 and max(rows)<=44 and min(cols)>=26 and max(cols)<=37 and n['pixels']>20:
            if n['color']=='p': pur+=n['pixels']
            else: wh+=n['pixels']
    return (pur,wh)
